description: Decay envelope with a VCA built in: a trigger restarts the fall, and the envelope opens the audio path

params.text: Sets the decay length as a fraction of whatever the range switch allows, with a floor of 1ms
Picks the longest decay the knob can reach: 30ms, 200ms or 5 seconds

inputs.text: Shifts the decay length, a fifth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob and clamped at each end
A rising edge above 1V restarts the envelope at its 5V peak
The signal the envelope opens; it passes at full level while the envelope is at 5V and is silent once the envelope has fallen away

outputs.text: The envelope, jumping to 5V at each trigger and falling exponentially towards 0V
The audio input multiplied by the envelope

notes: the lamp beside the range switch follows the height of the envelope.
the knob sets one time constant, so the envelope falls to about a third of its height in that time, and it is cut to 0V once it drops below 1mV.

inputs.0:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
